purpose: Teach: つけ加え/まるまる/たんに/思いのほか/ガタガタ/やっとこ/おのずから/じっさい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文末に絵文字つけ加えるなよ
lines.en: Riku, stop putting emojis at the end of your messages.
lines.style: Light, teasing jab. Quick and easy confidence. The tone of someone calling out a friend's harmless habit without any real bite.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、休みをまるまるゲームに使ったろ、桜
lines.en: You spent your whole break gaming, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet deflection, slight edge underneath. Not defensive exactly — more like he's turning it back on her with a small, knowing smile. Dry.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、たんに眠いだけだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're just tired, aren't you?
lines.style: Knowing observation underneath the tease. Softer than the last line — she's caught him and is giving him an out, but she's not letting him off completely.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト、思いのほか良かったな、桜
lines.en: Your test score came out better than expected, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine acknowledgment, carefully delivered. Not overstated. The kind of praise a friend offers without making a production of it — warm, steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、緊張で足ガタガタしてんな
lines.en: Riku, your leg is shaking from nerves.
lines.style: Casual observation, lightly mocking. She's noticed something he didn't realise he was doing. Comfortable enough to call it out, not cruel about it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、やっとこ宿題終わったか、桜
lines.en: Finally finished your homework, have you?
lines.style: Dry counter-tease. Matching her energy back. The rhythm of a back-and-forth that's been going on a while — knowing, easy, unbothered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、おのずから結果がついてくるよ
lines.en: Riku, the results will follow naturally if you keep at it.
lines.style: Shift to earnest. Quieter, more grounded. Still her — no performance, no reach — but the moment where the teasing stops and she means what she's saying. Steady.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、じっさい頑張ったよな、桜
lines.en: You really did try hard, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment of real effort. Not effusive. The kind of thing he might have practiced saying, but when it comes out it's genuine. Warmth without awkwardness.
